heading: Preview on a device
body: Preview accepts exactly one target. If you do not pass --target, Tachyon previews web. A native preview serves the web bundle inside a target that you already built with `ty bundle --target <target>`, so it checks no toolchain. With `--watch` it builds that target first and rebuilds it when a source changes; that build checks the platform SDK, compiler and WebView and reports any missing dependency.
